name: Belarusian (folk)
description: Belarusian folk constellations compiled for Stellarium.
source: Stellarium sky culture 'belarusian' (https://github.com/Stellarium/stellarium/tree/master/skycultures/belarusian); contributed by: The creation of this sky culture for Stellarium was suggested by Alexander Wolf to Johan Meuris, based on the article **Astronyms in Belarussian Folk Beliefs** by Tsimafei Avilin, published in the peer-reviewed journal Archaeologia Baltica. Illustrations by Johan Meuris.
HYG Database v4.1 (https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database), CC BY-SA 4.0, for stars not in constellations.json
